evidence.notes: Property package: NRTL (ethanol-water). Saturated-liquid feed (VF=0, 101325 Pa, 1 mol/s) into a valve; bubble T swept over x_EtOH 0.70-0.98, then 0.862-0.878 in 0.002 steps; minimum at x=0.868, T=351.5302 K, confirmed by a final solve (ok=true; mass residual 0, energy 3e-7). The curve is very flat (dT<0.0003 K over x=0.864-0.872), so x_az is good to about +/-0.004. Literature value is about 0.894 / 351.3 K.

Property package: NRTL (DWSIM), chosen for the polar, non-ideal, azeotrope-forming ethanol-water liquid. Two 1 mol/s streams of ethanol/water 0.5/0.5 at 101325 Pa: VF=0 gives T_bubble=352.97 K, VF=1 gives T_dew=357.56 K. solve ok=true, no solver errors; no units, so there are no balance residuals.

Property package: NRTL (polar, non-ideal methanol-water liquid at low pressure). Rigorous DWSIM column: 20 stages (1 = total condenser), feed at stage 10, R=1.5, B=60 mol/s, 1 atm, dP=0. Residuals: mass 7.4e-7, compound 3.1e-6, energy 1.1e-12. D=40 mol/s at 337.9 K, B at 372.2 K; duties are energy-stream magnitudes (Qc removed, Qr added).

Property package: NRTL (activity model for the polar, non-ideal methanol-water mixture). Built FEED (100 mol/s, 40/60 mol% MeOH/H2O, 355 K, 101325 Pa) -> separator FLASH -> VAP + LIQ; duty 0. Max residuals: mass 4.7e-6, compound 2.0e-5, energy 4.7e-6 (relative). V=53.67 mol/s, L=46.33 mol/s.
